name: Quote generation - 20 sheets white melamine chipboard 16mm
description: Customer requests a standard quote. AI should use generate_quote, return total and PDF link. No raw JSON/code in reply.

messages.text: My name is Test Customer, can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Core quote generation test. Verifies the PDF clamping fix (2750x1830 vs 2730x1810) doesn't regress.
